cases.case_name: Sri Light Chit Fund Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Sri Light Chit Fund Pvt. Ltd. ka case tha. Department ne pehle ek reassessment kiya, fir usi ke basis par ek aur consequential assessment bana diya.
cases.issue: Agar original reassessment ko radd kar diya jaye to us par aadharit dusra assessment valid hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki jab pehla reassessment hi radd ho gaya hai to us par bane anya assessment bhi apne aap khatam ho jate hain.
cases.takeaway: Agar ek reassessment order radd ho jaye, to uske basis par bane kisi bhi aur assessment ke khilaf turant action lo, kyunki wo bhi automatically invalid ho jayega.

cases.case_name: Sunil Devchand Ghudka Vs ITO (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.facts: Sunil Devchand Ghudka ke case mein reassessment notice ke liye Section 151 approval di gayi thi magar wo approval sign nahi thi.
cases.issue: Kya bina sign wali Section 151 approval se reassessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha bina sign wali approval valid nahi hai, isliye reassessment ko radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Reassessment approval hamesha properly sign honi chahiye. Bina sign ki approval agar mili hai to uske against asani se relief mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Mahabhadra Constructions Limited Vs NFAC (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Mahabhadra Constructions ka case tha. Section 14A ke tahat kuch disallowance hui thi aur us par penalty Section 271(1)(c) lagi thi.
cases.issue: Jab Section 14A ki disallowance set aside ho jaye to penalty Section 271(1)(c) ke tahat tikti hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki jab original disallowance hi set aside ho gayi hai, toh us par lagi penalty bhi ab nahi chal sakti.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap par penalty sirf ek disallowance ki wajah se lagi hai, aur wo disallowance set aside ho jaye, toh penalty automatically khatam ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Snehal N. Muzoomdar Vs Union of India & Anr.
cases.facts: Snehal N. Muzoomdar ka case tha. NFRA ne auditor ke khilaf proceedings shuru ki thi jo allegedly tainted the.
cases.issue: Kya NFRA ki powers valid hain aur kya tainted auditor proceedings ko quash kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne bola ki NFRA ki powers valid hain, lekin specific case mein auditor ke khilaf proceedings radd kar di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke khilaf NFRA ki proceedings chal rahi hain, to har ek ground detail mein check karo. Agar koi fundamental galati dikhe to court relief de sakta hai.

cases.facts: Ek taxpayer ke khilaf ek hi matter par do GST assessments chal rahi thi, dono input tax credit (ITC) se judi thi.
cases.issue: Kya ek hi mudde par do alag alag GST assessments allowed hain?
cases.held: Madras High Court ne parallel GST assessment ko radd kar diya, kyunki ek hi cheez par do baar adjudication allowed nahi hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke against ek hi ITC ka duplicate assessment notice aaye, to uspar turant objection uthao. Double assessment same mudde par nahi ho sakta.

cases.facts: YRF Films ka case tha. Overseas shoot ki payments ke upar Rs. 46 crore ka service tax demand aaya tha. Overseas agents sirf intermediaries the, producer nahi.
cases.issue: Kya overseas shoot payments par reverse charge mein India mein service tax lag sakta hai?
cases.held: CESTAT ne bola ki jab agent ya intermediary hai, producer nahi, to reverse charge se service tax applicable nahi hai. Rs. 46 crore ka poora tax demand radd ho gaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap kahin bahar shoot kar rahe hain aur payment wahan ke agent ko ja rahi hai, to check karo kya wo intermediary hai ya actual service provider. Intermediary ho to likely India mein service tax nahi lagega.

cases.case_name: Akola Zilla Mahasul Karmchari Sahkari Pat Sanstha Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Nagpur)
cases.facts: Yeh ek co-operative society ka case tha. Inhone apni income tax return late file ki thi. Department ne ₹35.17 lakh ka Section 80P deduction rok liya, kyunki return time se nahi diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya co-operative society ko Section 80P ka deduction mil sakta hai agar return late file ho gayi ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne decide kiya ki deduction dena chahiye. Sirf is wajah se ki return late file hui, deduction nahi roka ja sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap co-operative society hain aur kisi wajah se return late ho gayi, toh bhi Section 80P ka claim reject hone par ITAT ja sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Contray Liquar Shop Vs ITO (ITAT Nagpur)
cases.facts: Contray Liquar Shop par department ne ₹34.89 lakh ka addition kiya salary, creditors aur licence fee ke issue par. Assessee ne appeal ki.
cases.issue: Kya department ki taraf se ki gayi additions sahi thi ya fir in matters ko dobara examine karna chahiye?
cases.held: ITAT ne case wapas assessing officer ko bhej diya ki dubara saari cheezen check karo.
cases.takeaway: Agar major additions ho aur saboot acche se check nahi hue, toh matter wapas assessing officer ke pass ja sakta hai. Prepare ho ke jao, saare document ready rakho.

cases.case_name: Gem And Jewellery Export Promotion Council Vs State of Maharashtra (Supreme Court)
cases.facts: Jewellery trade shows mein paid entry ke upar Maharashtra ne entertainment duty laga di thi. Organisers ne challenge kiya tha ki aisa nahi hona chahiye.
cases.issue: Kya jewellery trade shows ke paid entry par entertainment duty lag sakta hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne decide kiya ki state entertainment duty charge kar sakti hai, chahe event business purpose ka ho.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap trade fairs ya similar events paid entry ke saath organise karte hain, toh local entertainment duty ka kharcha plan karen.

cases.case_name: Ringlets Tradex Pvt Ltd Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Ringlets Tradex ke case mein department ne third-party documents ke basis par Section 153C notice diya tha, par satisfaction note galat tha.
cases.issue: Kya defective satisfaction note par Section 153C ki proceedings chal sakti hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne Section 153C notice ko radd kar diya kyunki satisfaction note proper nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko third-party documents ke basis par notice milta hai, toh check karo ki satisfaction note sahi hai ya nahi, warna aapka case bhi cancel ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Madhao Kulkarni Vs ITO (ITAT Nagpur)
cases.facts: Assessee ne property bechkar naya ghar kharida, par registration late hua. Department ne Section 54 deduction roka diya, kyunki registry timely nahi hui.
cases.issue: Kya property ki registry late hone par bhi Section 54 ka deduction mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki jab fund transfer timely hua hai aur intention clear hai, toh sirf registry late hone se deduction nahi roka ja sakta.
cases.takeaway: Ghar bech kar nayi property mein timely invest kiya hai toh registry late ho tab bhi Section 54 ka benefit claim kar sakte ho, boss!

cases.case_name: Rameshbhai Bhikhabhai Bajaniya Vs ITO (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Assessee ke khate mein unexplained cash credit mila. Section 68 ke under addition confirm ho gaya, par department ne 60% special tax Section 115BBE se bhi lagaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 addition par hamesha Section 115BBE ka 60% tax lagna zaroori hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition to maintain rakha, magar 60% special tax hata diya, kyunki proper justification nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap par Section 68 ke under addition ho, toh check karo department ne Section 115BBE ka special tax lagaya hai ya nahi. Reason ka demand karo.

cases.case_name: Devraju Gajji Vs ITO (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Demonetisation se pehle ka cash balance bank mein deposit kiya tha. Department ne Section 69A lagakar addition kiya, bola ki yeh unexplained hai.
cases.issue: Kya demonetisation se pehle wala cash balance accept ho sakta hai agar saboot hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya kyunki assessee ne proof de diya ki yeh purana cash genuinely balance mein tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar demonetisation ke time cash deposit pe problem aaye, toh pehle ka cash ka proof bank/records se dikhana bahut zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Chhaganbhai Nanubhai Butani Vs ITO (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Chhaganbhai Nanubhai Butani ka case tha. Department ne unke khilaf assessment year 2015-16 ka purana reassessment khola. Notice Section 148 ke tahat diya gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya purana reassessment notice time-barred tha?
cases.held: ITAT Surat ne kaha ye notice time-barred hai, isliye pura reassessment radd kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko bhi Section 148 ka notice aaye to check karo ki notice time limit ke andar hai ya nahi. Agar purana hai to appeal karo.

cases.case_name: Lagisetty Viswanatham Vs ITO (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Lagisetty Viswanatham ke case mein demonetisation ke samay ₹35.85 lakh ka cash addition hua tha. Department ne yeh paisa unexplained income mana.
cases.issue: Kya demonetisation period ki cash deposit ko unexplained income mana jaa sakta hai jab explanation di gayi ho?
cases.held: ITAT Hyderabad ne yeh addition hata diya. Assessee ka explanation theek mana gaya.
cases.takeaway: Demonetisation ke paison ka source sahi document se explain karo to addition cancel ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Rajshri Construction Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Rajshri Construction ko NBFC loan par diye gaye interest ka ₹20.28 lakh ka deduction nahi diya gaya tha. Department ne interest expense disallow kar diya.
cases.issue: NBFC se liye gaye loan par interest disallow kiya jaa sakta hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne interest disallowance hata diya. NBFC loan par interest allowable hai.
cases.takeaway: NBFC loan ka interest, agar actual business purpose mein hai, to deduction milega. Document proper hone chahiye.

cases.case_name: C.E. Info Systems Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: C.E. Info Systems Limited ne tax-neutral reclassification ki wajah se ₹1.59 crore ki disallowance Section 57 ke tahat challenge ki. Department ne galat tarike se disallowance laga diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya tax-neutral reclassification par Section 57 ka disallowance lagaya jaa sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne disallowance hata diya. Tax-neutral reclassification par disallowance sahi nahi hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar transaction tax-neutral hai, to Section 57 ka disallowance justify nahi hai. Apna tax treatment clear dikhana chahiye.

cases.case_name: Delhi Hardware Stores Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Delhi Hardware Stores ne Section 148 notice ke baad return file kiya tha. Department ne is par Section 270A penalty laga di.
cases.issue: Kya return file karne par bhi Section 270A penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty hata di. Return filed karne par sahi compliance hui thi, isliye penalty ka reason nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapne Section 148 ke notice ke baad return file ki hai, to penalty Section 270A automatically nahi lagegi. Notice ka proper response do.

cases.facts: Ek truck operator ke upar ₹2.73 crore ki demand lagi thi kyunki department ne GTA (Goods Transport Agency) service tax laga diya tha. Par truck operator ne kabhi consignment note issue nahi kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina consignment note ke trucking par GTA service tax lag sakta hai?
cases.held: CESTAT ne pura demand set aside kar diya. Jab consignment note nahi hai to wo GTA service nahi mani jaayegi aur service tax nahi lagega.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap truck operator ho aur consignment note issue nahi karte, to aap par GTA service tax ka demand nahi banega.

cases.case_name: Board of Control for Cricket in India Vs Pankaj Srivastava & Ors. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: BCCI ne NCLAT Chennai ke order ke khilaaf Supreme Court mein appeal ki thi. Corporate dispute tha, detail raw item mein nahi hai.
cases.issue: Kya NCLAT ka order sahi tha ya usay radd karna chahiye tha?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne BCCI ki appeal kharij kar di. Iska matlab NCLAT ka order ab final hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar NCLAT ne aapke khilaaf order diya hai, to Supreme Court se bhi relief milna mushkil ho sakta hai. Prepare strong grounds.

cases.case_name: Swaati Nirkhi & Ors. Vs State (NCT of Delhi) & Ors. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Ek criminal matter tha jahan trial ki jagah par sawal tha. Matter me accused ne trial ki jagah badalne ki baat ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya criminal trial ka venue badla ja sakta hai ya jahan offence hua wahi chalega?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne kaha ki aam taur par criminal trial ussi jagah hona chahiye jahan offence hua hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap criminal case face kar rahe hain, to trial location sirf special cases me hi badlegi. Aam taur pe offence wali jagah hi chalega.

cases.case_name: Indore Sahakari Dugdh Sangh Maryadit Vs ACIT/ITO (ITAT Indore)
cases.facts: Ek cooperative society jo dudh ka business karti hai. Interest income coop bank se mila tha, department ne deduction deny kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya cooperative bank se mile interest par Section 80P(2)(d) ka deduction milega?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha ki cooperative society ko bank interest par deduction allowed hai. Section 80P(2)(d) yahi allow karta hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar cooperative society ho aur bank interest mil raha ho, to Section 80P(2)(d) ke liye claim zarur karo. Bank statement ready rakho.

cases.case_name: Delta Farm Services Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Firm ne farmers ko cash me tractor becha. Department ne upar se penalty lagayi ki cash sale limit cross ho gayi.
cases.issue: Kya jam kar cash sale par section 271DA ki penalty lagegi?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty hata di. Bola ki farmers ki khas condition dekh ke aisa kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar cash me sale farmers ko hain jahan banking mushkil hai, aur genuine case ho, to penalty se bachne ka chance hai. Buyer details dikhana zaruri hai.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Lilavati Kirtilal Mehta Medical Trust (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Trust ne medical emergency me cash receive kiya. Department ne cash limit cross hone par penalty lagayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya medical emergencies me bhi section 271DA ki penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola emergencies me cash lena justified tha, penalty hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar hospital ya trust ke paas emergency me cash aata hai, to details aur emergency document ready rakho. Waisa record lagana jaruri hai.

cases.case_name: Vijay Sharma Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Assessee ne credit card se kharch kiye the. Department ne poocha ki kyun ye expenses disallow na kiye jaye jab inka koi deduction claim nahi hua tha aur paisa ka source bhi explain kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya credit card se kiye kharch disallow ho sakte hain jab deduction claim nahi hua aur source bataya hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki jab deduction manga hi nahi aur source of funds bhi explain kar diya, to aise expenses ko disallow nahi kiya ja sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar expense ka deduction hi nahi manga, aur paisa ka source bataya hai, to usko disallow nahi kiya ja sakta. Return file karte waqt row wise claim verify kar lo.

cases.case_name: Nitin Singhania Vs CIT(A) (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Assessee ne 80GGC pe deduction claim ki thi, lekin payment ka proof nahi diya. Department ne us deduction ko mana kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya bina payment proof ke Section 80GGC deduction mil sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, bina payment ka evidence diye deduction nahi milegi. Disallowance sahi hai.
cases.takeaway: Section 80GGC ya kisi bhi deduction par payment ka poora proof jama karna zaruri hai. Payment ka record maintain karna na bhoolen.

cases.case_name: Vikas Tyagi Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Assessee ne 8 lakh ki commission expense dikhayi. Par koi bhi service evidence nahi diya. Department ne pura disallow kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya commission disallow ho sakti hai jab koi bhi service ka evidence nahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne disallowance ko maintain kiya. Bola ki service ka proof nahi diya to expense mana ja sakta hai.
cases.takeaway: Commission aur service payment ka koi bhi expense claim karte samay us service ka proof sambhal kar rakhein. Sirf bill ya entry se kaam nahi chalega.

cases.case_name: Oppo Mobiles India Private Limited Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: CPC ne assessee ka return bina pehle notice diye adjust kar diya. Assessee ne challenge kiya ki notice dena zaruri hota hai.
cases.issue: Kya bina notice diye CPC adjustment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bina notice ke adjustment ko radd kar diya. Notice dena mandatory hai.
cases.takeaway: CPC agar koi adjustment kare to pehle aapko notice milna zaruri hai. Agar notice nahi mila, to aap turant appeal file karo.

cases.case_name: Suman Lata Vs ITO (ITAT Raipur)
cases.facts: Department ne assessee ko Section 148 ka notice galat officer ke through bheja. Assessee ne is galati ko highlight kiya.
cases.issue: Kya Section 148 ka notice valid hai agar galat officer bheje?
cases.held: ITAT ne notice ko radd kar diya. Sirf right officer hi notice bhej sakta hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko Section 148 ka notice aaye to officer ka jurisdiction check karna na bhoolen. Galat officer ka notice hamesha challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Quickpaisa Fintech Private Limited Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Department ne 153C proceeding shuru ki par satisfaction note theek se nahi banaya. Is wajah se assessee ne challenge kiya.
cases.issue: Kya Section 153C assessment chal sakti hai agar satisfaction note defective ho?
cases.held: ITAT ne assessment ko radd kar diya. Bola, procedure galat hua hai to pura case khatam.
cases.takeaway: 153C ka case ho to hamesha satisfaction note detail mein check karo. Agar document sahi nahi mile, turant object karo.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Lalit Kumar (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Yahan ek employee sirf bank account ka authorised signatory tha. Department ne unke naam par rakhe paise ko unki income maan liya. Sirf is basis par addition kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya ek employee sirf signatory hone par uske naam ki entry ko uski income maana ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne kaha ki employee sirf signatory tha, paise ka asli malik nahi tha. Toh Section 69A ka addition galat tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap sirf kisi firm ya boss ke bank account ke authorised signatory ho, toh us account mein aaye paise aapki income nahi mani jayegi. Yeh cheez prove karne ke liye aapko supporting documents dikhane honge.

cases.case_name: Ridcor Infra Projects Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Company ne cash receipt li thi, jo usually Section 269ST ke under allowed nahi hai. Company ne bola ki situation business necessity ki thi.
cases.issue: Business necessity hone par kya Section 269ST ka penalty hat sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne dekha ki business necessity prove ho gayi thi. Penalty hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko cash mein paisa lena pad jaaye aur reason genuine business necessity ka hai, toh penalty nahi lagegi - par document ready rakhein ki necessity kya thi.

cases.case_name: Shree Balaji Metal Works Vs Union of India (Rajasthan High Court)
cases.facts: GST ki proceeding mein Section 74 laga tha. Department ne limitation ko lekar objection uthaya ki appeal time se nahi lagi.
cases.issue: Kya delay hone par bhi Section 74 appeal ki sunwai ho sakti hai?
cases.held: High Court ne kaha ki limitation wala objection yahan lagu nahi hota. Appeal allow kar di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapki GST appeal me thoda delay ho gaya, to bhi court appeal consider kar sakta hai jab limitation ka objection applicable nahi ho.

cases.case_name: Laxminaryan Patidar Vs ITO (ITAT Indore)
cases.facts: Tribunal ke saamne ex-parte order aaya tha. Yeh order bina assessee ko sahi mauka diye pass hua tha.
cases.issue: Bina assessee ki baat sune order pass hua to kya wo valid hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne ex-parte order ko set aside kar diya. Case ko fresh hearing ke liye wapas bhej diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka case ex-parte decide ho gaya hai bina aapki bat sune, toh aap fresh sunwai mang sakte hain.

cases.facts: AO ne art purchase ko shareholder benefit samjh liya. Art ek Dubai ki company ke naam books mein dikhaya tha, fir bhi addition kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya company books mein dikhaya asset bhi deemed dividend maana jaa sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne addition hata diya, bola jab asset company ki books mein hai to shareholding benefit nahi maana jaa sakta.
cases.takeaway: Foreign company ke naam books mein expense dikha ho, aur asset company ki property ho to usko aapka personal benefit nahi maana jayega.

cases.case_name: BKR Capital Pvt. Ltd Vs ITO (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: BKR Capital Pvt Ltd ka case tha jisme Income Tax Department ne reassessment ki limitation ka mudda uthaya. Company ki taraf se yeh bola gaya ki limitation period cross ho chuka hai. Delhi High Court ne unke favour mein faisla diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment ki limitation cross ho chuki thi ya nahi?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne Delhi High Court ke faisle ko challenge karne se mana kar diya. Matlab, High Court ka faisla final maana gaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar Delhi High Court limitation ke favor mein decision de de, aur Supreme Court interfere na kare, to woh decision final hai. Limitation rules ko dhyan se check karo.

cases.case_name: Asha Daga Vs DCIT (ITAT Raipur)
cases.facts: Asha Daga ka jewelry ka case tha. Assessment mein gold jewellery aur bullion dono add kar diye gaye the. CBDT Instruction 1916 ke basis par gold jewellery ka kuch hissa reduce kar diya gaya, lekin bullion ki puri addition ko uphold kiya gaya.
cases.issue: Kya puri gold jewellery aur bullion ki addition sahi thi, ya CBDT Instruction 1916 lagti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki gold jewellery pe CBDT ka instruction lagu hota hai, isliye uski addition kam kar di. Lekin bullion pe yeh instruction lagu nahi hoti, isliye addition maintain rahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar gold jewellery ka case ho to CBDT Instruction 1916 ka reference le sakte ho. Lekin bullion pe yeh benefit nahi milega.

cases.case_name: Lalit Kumar Nagar Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Lalit Kumar Nagar ke against Section 153C ke tahat 7 saal ki assessments open ki gayi thi. Assessing Officer ne satisfaction note April 2021 ke baad record ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya April 2021 ke baad satisfaction record ki gayi assessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne assessment ko radd kar diya kyunki April 2021 ke baad 153C proceedings suru karna law ke khilaf hai.
cases.takeaway: Section 153C (third party search/warrant) ka case ho, toh April 2021 ke baad agar AO satisfaction note likhe to poori assessment radd ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Ashutosh Agarwal Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Ashutosh Agarwal ka case tha jisme 153C ke tahat 3 saalon ki assessment open hui thi. April 2021 ke baad satisfaction record hua tha. ITAT ne 10 saal ki block period ki limit bhi consider ki.
cases.issue: Kya April 2021 ke baad ki satisfaction se assessment chal sakta hai 10 saal ke block ke under?
cases.held: ITAT ne assessment radd kar di kyunki AO ne April 2021 ke baad satisfaction record ki thi, jo law ke khilaf hai; 10 saal ka block bhi applicable hai.
cases.takeaway: 153C cases mein April 2021 cut-off aur 10 saal ki limit dono check karo, warna puri assessment radd ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Rajendra Kumar (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Rajendra Kumar ke khilaf Section 153C ki proceedings shuru hui thi, lekin AO ne 1 April 2021 ke baad satisfaction record kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya 1 April 2021 ke baad satisfaction likhne se 153C assessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne assessment ko radd kar diya kyunki satisfaction note 1 April 2021 ke baad likhi gayi thi. Law ne aisa mana kiya hai.
cases.takeaway: 153C ki assessment ka notice ya satisfaction agar April 2021 ke baad ho to usko challenge karo, assessment radd ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Genpact India Holdings Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Genpact India ka reassessment case tha. Section 151(ii) ke approval mein kuch galti thi isliye reopening ki action li gayi thi. Department ne upar se approval liya tha lekin proper authority se nahi liya.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment sahi hai jab Section 151(ii) approval valid nahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment ko radd kar diya kyunki Section 151(ii) ka proper approval nahi tha, jo mandatory hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar reassessment ho aur Section 151(ii) ka approval galat ya incomplete ho, to pura case radd ho sakta hai. Notice ya order ki copy attentively check karo.

cases.facts: Exporters ne IGST refund ki demand ki thi. Rule 96(10) export refund ka rule tha jo ab omit ho chuka hai. Government ne koi saving clause nahi diya tha. Court ke saamne yeh mudda tha ki refund dena hai ya nahi.
cases.issue: Rule omit hone ke baad bhi IGST refund dena hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Karnataka High Court ne bola ki rule hatne ke baad igst refund roka nahi ja sakta. Saving clause nahi tha to exporters ko relief mil gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar export refund ka Rule 96(10) omit ho gaya ho tab bhi refund claim karo. Rule ke hatne ke baad bhi hak banta hai.

cases.case_name: Dhaval Muktibhai Shah Vs ITO (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.facts: Assessee ne political donation ka ₹4 lakh dikhaya. Department ne reassessment notice diya ki income chhupai hai. Ye notice time ke bahar diya gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya political donation ke basis par ki gayi reassessment time ke andar thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha reassessment notice time-barred hai. Time ke baad diya notice valid nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar assessment ka notice time ke bahar aaye, turant challenge karo. Time limit ki copy aur notice milte hi proof sambhal ke rakho.

cases.case_name: Jagannath Anveerappa Dukandar Vs ITO (ITAT Bangalore)
cases.facts: Assessee ne ₹3.48 crore cash deposit kiya. Department ne poocha ye paisa kahan se aaya. Assessee ne books aur invoice se sab kuch explain kiya.
cases.issue: Kya cash deposit ka pura explanation diya gaya?
cases.held: ITAT ne additions hata diye kyunki books aur invoice se source clear ho gaya tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar bank cash deposit pucha jaye, turant apne books aur invoices dikhana. Har entry ka paper tayyar raho.

cases.case_name: Shresth Gupta Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Assessee ke khilaf reassessment mein ₹1.72 crore add kiya gaya. Magar department ke paas koi zabt ki gayi cheez nahi thi.
cases.issue: Kya jab seizure material nahi milta to bhi reassessment ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha jab koi seized material nahi hai to addition valid nahi. Addition delete kiya.
cases.takeaway: Agar addition seized material par based nahi hai to court mein point uthao. Survey ki cheezon ki list banake rakho.

cases.case_name: Dineshkumar And Co. Vs ITO (ITAT Rajkot)
cases.facts: Assessment limited scrutiny mein khola gaya tha. Department ne us notice se bahar ka issue utha liya.
cases.issue: Kya assessment limited scrutiny ke scope se bahar ja sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne poori assessment quash kar di. Department sirf notice ke points tak hi limited hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar department notice ke bahar ka point add kare, turant likhit objection do. Har notice ki copy sambhal ke rakho.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Maan Infosystems Pvt. Ltd. (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Department ne Section 68 ke tahat addition kiya. Par yeh galat assessment year me kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 ka addition galat assessment year me ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya. Galat year me ki gayi addition valid nahi hoti.
cases.takeaway: Department agar galat year me addition kare, to turant us point ko highlight karo.

cases.case_name: Sanya Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Assessee ne land par depreciation claim kiya. Department ne disallow kiya aur penalty laga di.
cases.issue: Kya sirf depreciation disallow hone se Section 271(1)(c) penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty hata di. Galti se depreciation claim hua to automatic penalty nahi lagti.
cases.takeaway: Agar claim galti se hua ho aur koi bad intention na ho to penalty court me challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Dattatreya Ghosh Vs ITO (ITAT Bangalore)
cases.facts: Assessee ne ek property bechi, par registry baad mein hui. Income Tax Department ne ₹37.60 lakh ka addition registry ki date ke hisaab se kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya property ke registration date ke basis par addition sahi thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya. Court ne dekha ki registry delay facts ke hisaab se hua tha, aur sale pehle ho chuki thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar sale agreement pehle ka hai aur registry baad ki, to sirf registry ke delay pe tax addition nahi banta. Document ki date pe bhi focus rakho.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Navitasys India Private Limited (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Department ne ₹685.42 crore ka GST se related addition kiya. ITAT ne kaha ki audit report ka verification hona zaruri hai.
cases.issue: Kya GST addition bina audit report verify kiye ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne matter wapas bhej diya. Saaf bola ki pehle audit report ki checking ho, tabhi decide hoga.
cases.takeaway: Badi GST related entries par bina proper audit report verify kiye addition safe nahi hai. Audit se related document ready rakho.

cases.case_name: Satya Narayan Bairwa Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Assessee ka case dubara khola gaya, lekin approval sahi tareeke se nahi liya gaya tha. Section 151 Income Tax Act approval ki process batata hai.
cases.issue: Kya bina valid sanction ke reassessment ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment radd kar diya kyunki Section 151 approval theek nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Reassessment ka notice tabhi valid hai jab approval full process follow karke liya ho. Notice milte hi approval copy maang lo.

cases.case_name: Uttar Pradesh Avas Evam Vikas Parishad & Anr. Vs Gaursons India Pvt. Ltd. & Ors. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Developer par ₹388 crore demand laga diya gaya tha land allotment se related. Supreme Court ne is demand ko dekha.
cases.issue: Kya replacement land allotment pe itni badi demand sahi thi?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne pura demand radd kar diya. Bola, demand ki koi legal basis nahi thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap pe kisi authority ne huge demand laga di aur vo reasoned nahi hai, to Supreme Court tak challenge kar sakte ho. Har document ki legal basis samajh lo.

cases.case_name: Birendra Kumar Agrawal Vs S2 Tech.com India Pvt Ltd and another (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: NCLAT ne ek order diya bina acche se sunwayi kiye. Party ne Supreme Court mein challenge kiya.
cases.issue: Kya bina fair hearing ke order valid hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne NCLAT ka order set aside kar diya, bola sunwayi sab ka right hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar tribunal se sunwayi ka mauka nahi mila, Supreme Court ja kar order radd karwa sakte ho. Notice milte hi har hearing attend karo.

cases.case_name: Delhi Development Authority Vs Rajender Kumar Sharma (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: DDA ke kuch employees ko gratuity aur uspar interest nahi diya ja raha tha, jab ki unko court se zuroorat thi. Employees pehle acquit ho gaye the.
cases.issue: Kya acquitted employees ko gratuity ke sath interest milna chahiye?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne saaf bola, gratuity ke sath interest bhi milega, acquittal ke baad rok nahi sakte.
cases.takeaway: Agar koi disciplinary ya criminal case clear ho jaye, employer ko gratuity aur interest dono dena padega. Delay ke documents rakhna.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Navitasys India Private Limited (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Navitasys India Private Limited ka case tha. GST ki wajah se ₹685.42 crore ka income tax addition hua tha. Department ne addition kiya, audit report verify nahi hui thi.
cases.issue: Kya audit report ki verify kiye bina GST addition justify hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne case wapas bhej diya audit report ko dobara check karne ke liye. Final faisla audit ki report dekh kar hoga.
cases.takeaway: Agar GST ya koi bhi badi entry pe doubt hai, to audit report ki verification sabse pehle kara lo. Verification ke bina addition tik nahi sakta.

cases.case_name: Delhi Development Authority Vs Rajender Kumar Sharma (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: DDA ke kuch employees ko pehle charge laga tha, baad mein court ne unko bari kar diya. Inhone Gradutity aur us par interest ki demand ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya acquit hone ke baad gratuity with interest milna chahiye ya nahi?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne bola acquit ho gaye to gratuity aur us par interest dono milegi. DDA ko paisa dena hi padega.
cases.takeaway: Agar kisi pe case tha aur wo acquit ho gaya, to apna gratuity ka pura claim karo, interest samet. Employer mana nahi kar sakta.

cases.case_name: Satya Narayan Bairwa Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Satya Narayan Bairwa ke case mein reassessment notice diya gaya. Section 151, jo hai higher authority ki approval ka section, wahaan approval galat tariqe se hua tha.
cases.issue: Kya galat approval ke basis par reassessment tik sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola Section 151 ka approval valid nahi tha, isliye reassessment notice ko radd kar diya gaya.
cases.takeaway: Reassessment notice milte hi approval wali file copy mangwao. Higher authority ka sahi sign nahi hai to pura notice khatam ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Mohammed Mustaque Ahmed Vs JCIT (ITAT Bangalore)
cases.facts: Mohammed Mustaque Ahmed ne property bechi aur cash mein payment liya. Section 269SS ke tahat cash mein payment allowed nahi hai.
cases.issue: Kya sirf cash property sale karne pe penalty lagni chahiye?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola penalty tab lagti hai jab galat niyat ho. Yahan pe genuine circumstances the, isliye penalty hata di.
cases.takeaway: Agar cash mein deal ho gayi aur genuine wajah hai, to penalty notice milne par explain karo. Court circumstances bhi dekhta hai, sirf rule nahi.

cases.case_name: Narayan Vedavathi Vs DCIT (Karnataka High Court)
cases.facts: Narayan Vedavathi ka jewellery income tax raid mein seize hua tha. ITAT se relief mil gaya tha. Ab jewellery wapas lene ki application di.
cases.issue: ITAT se relief milne ke baad kya jewellery release ho sakti hai?
cases.held: High Court ne applications allow kar di. Jewellery release ke liye IT department ko instructions de diye.
cases.takeaway: Agar ITAT se jewellery pe relief aa jaye to turant release ke liye written application file karo. High Court se order mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Rakesh Prakash Vs DC/AC (ITAT Patna)
cases.facts: Rakesh Prakash ke case mein section 143(1) ke tahat PF aur ESI ki adjustments department ne kar di thi. Lekin issue debatable tha.
cases.issue: Kya section 143(1) mein debatable issue pe adjustment ho sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne adjustments ko radd kar diya. Bola debatable issue hai to section 143(1) ka use nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case mein section 143(1) mein aisi adjustment aa jaye jo debatable lagti ho, to turant appeal karo, relief mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Commissioner of Service Tax Vs Hardy Exploration & Production (India) Ltd. (Madras High Court)
cases.facts: Hardy Exploration & Production company floating rigs ke liye service tax refund le rahi thi. Department limitation ki baat kar raha tha.
cases.issue: Kya limitation ke wajah se service tax refund mana kiya ja sakta hai jab actual eligibility ho?
cases.held: High Court ne bola floating rigs export wali service pe refund dena hi padega, chaahe thoda late ho gaya ho.
cases.takeaway: Agar export service hai aur refund ka right banta hai to limitation ka bahana department nahi laga sakta. Eligibility sabse important hai.

cases.case_name: Commissioner of Service Tax Vs Hardy Exploration & Production (India) Ltd. (Madras High Court)
cases.facts: Yeh case floating rigs ke service tax refund se related tha. Department ne refund ko limitation period ki wajah se rok diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya floating rigs par service tax refund time limit ki wajah se mana kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Court ne yeh kaha ki floating rigs ka case alag hai aur limitation ka objection yahan barabar nahi lagta. Refund allow kar diya gaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar floating rigs ya special case hai aur time limit cross ho gaya hai, phir bhi refund claim reject ho toh court ja sakte ho.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Sundaram Fasteners Ltd. (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Company ne apni subsidiary ko loan diya tha. Department ne interest disallow kiya, bolte ki investment business ke liye nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya parent company ko subsidiary ko loan dene par bhi interest ka kharcha allow hoga?
cases.held: Tribunal ne dekha ki company ke paas apne funds the aur commercial fayda tha. Interest allow kar diya.
cases.takeaway: Parent-subsidiary loan mein, agar apne funds hain aur commercial fayda hai to interest ka kharcha valid hai.

cases.case_name: Madhuri Sudhir Joglekar Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Assessee ka case mein department ne Section 14A ka disallowance laga diya bina apni satisfaction ko record kiye.
cases.issue: Kya bina reason likhe Section 14A ka disallowance sahi hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne Section 14A disallowance delete kar diya kyunki Assessing Officer ne apne reasons record nahi kiye the.
cases.takeaway: Agar AO Section 14A lagaye bina likhe ki woh khush nahi hai taxpayer ke hisab se, toh wo disallowance radd ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Shalimar Corp. Ltd. (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Company ne 2 crore ka loan liya aur sirf teen din baad wapas kar diya. Department ne Section 68 ke tahat income maan liya.
cases.issue: Kya aise loan ko Section 68 ke andar income maana ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne addition hata diya kyunki loan genuine tha aur jaldi wapas ho gaya tha.
cases.takeaway: Short-term loan agar saaf documentary proof ke saath liya aur jaldi wapas ho gaya toh Section 68 nahi lagega.

cases.case_name: A2Z Infra Engineering LTD. Vs Union of India (Sikkim High Court)
cases.facts: Department ne GST ITC demand banayi thi, lekin baad mein Section 16 mein retrospective amendment ho gaya.
cases.issue: Kya purani ITC demand Section 16 ke retrospective change ke baad valid hai?
cases.held: Court ne ITC demand ko radd kar diya, kyunki law mein wapas se amendment hone se ab demand nahi ban sakti thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar koi demand sirf purane law ki wajah se thi aur law mein change retrospective hai, toh demand automatically khatam ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Global Jewellery Vs Assessment Unit (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Global Jewellery ka business hai. Income Tax Department ne ₹1.71 crore ke purchase ko bogus maan kar Section 69C ke tahat addition kar di thi. Department ne bola ki purchases ka source explain nahi hua.
cases.issue: Kya purchase add kar ke taxable income badhai ja sakti hai jab source nahi bata?
cases.held: ITAT ne yeh addition hata di. Court ne dekha ki purchases genuine the aur unka source explain ho gaya tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap apne purchases ka proper record aur payment proof dikhate ho, to bogus addition Section 69C me hata sakte ho.

cases.case_name: ACIT Vs Sundaram Fasteners Ltd. (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Sundaram Fasteners Ltd. ne apni subsidiary ko loan diya tha. Interest ka deduction claim kiya. Department ne mana kar diya ki yeh business ke liye nahi hai.
cases.issue: Kya parent company subsidiary ko diye loan pe interest deduction claim kar sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola jab company ke paas khud ka paisa ho, aur loan business fayde ke liye diya ho to deduction mana nahi ja sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap apne funds se subsidiary ko loan dete ho business purpose ke liye to interest deduction milega. Record main business motive jarur dikhayein.

cases.case_name: Madhuri Sudhir Joglekar Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Madhuri Sudhir Joglekar ka case tha. Department ne Section 14A laga kar kuch expenditure disallow kar diya bina satisfy kiye ki kya record sahi hai.
cases.issue: Kya Section 14A lagane se pehle Assessing Officer ko satisfaction record karna jaruri hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya kyunki AO ne satisfaction record nahi ki thi jaise law me bola gaya hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar AO khud likh kar nahi batata ki aapke records kyon galat hain, to Section 14A ki disallowance challenge ho sakti hai.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Shalimar Corp. Ltd. (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Shalimar Corp Ltd. ne kisi se loan liya aur teen din baad wapas kar diya. Department ne bola yeh amount unexplained hai aur Section 68 laga diya.
cases.issue: Tez time me loan lene aur lotane par Section 68 lag sakta hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di. Bola paisa wapas kar diya gaya isliye unexplained nahi maan sakte.
cases.takeaway: Agar loan lena aur jaldi lotana bilkul genuine dikh raha hai to Section 68 ka addition kat sakta hai. Document sab dikhayein.

cases.case_name: A2Z Infra Engineering LTD. Vs Union of India (Sikkim High Court)
cases.facts: A2Z Infra Engineering Ltd. ka GST ITC ka demand tha. Department ne ITC deny kar diya. High Court ne dekha ki Section 16 me retrospective amendment hua hai.
cases.issue: Kya retrospective change ke baad bhi ITC demand valid hai?
cases.held: Court ne demand ko radd kar diya, kyunki retrospective law ke baad old ITC demand valid nahi tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka ITC law change hone se pehle ka hai, to department ka demand valid nahi ho sakta. Nabhi amendment check karein.

cases.case_name: Abbur Subramanyam Venkata Kumar Vs ITO (International Taxation) (ITAT Bangalore)
cases.facts: Abbur Subramanyam Venkata Kumar ko 6 saal ke baad reassessment notice bheja gaya tha. Department ne limitation period cross kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya 6 saal ke baad reassessment notice valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne notice ko radd kar diya, bola time limit cross ho gaya tha isliye action valid nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko 6 saal ke baad bhi reassessment notice aaye, to turant limitation ka point uthayein.

cases.case_name: Footballco Intermediate Cooperatief U.A. Netherlands Vs Board for Advance Rulings (Delhi High Court)
cases.facts: Ye ek foreign company ka case tha. Inhone advance ruling ke liye apply kiya tha. Board ne hearing ki date time pe nahi batayi.
cases.issue: Kya advance ruling ki hearing ki date 15 din ke andar applicant ko batai jaani chahiye?
cases.held: Court ne bola hearing ki date 15 din ke andar communicate karni zaroori hai. Agar nahi karte, to process galat hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap advance ruling ke liye apply karte hain, to 15 din ke andar hearing ka intzaar karein. Nahi aaye, to rectification ki demand karein.

cases.case_name: C.M. Gopal Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Assessee ke yahan search hua tha. Jewellery ki poori value ko income maan liya gaya. CBDT Instruction No. 1916 ke hisaab se kuch limit allowed thi.
cases.issue: Kya poori jewellery ko addition maana jaa sakta hai ya CBDT ki instruction se relief mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne CBDT Instruction No. 1916 follow ki aur saari jewellery addition hata di. Authority ki guidelines maani gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar ghar mein jewellery ki search ho, to CBDT ki 1916 instruction ka reference jaroor de. Uske weight limit ke hisaab se relief mil sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Gas Supply Co. Pvt. Ltd. Vs ACIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Company ka search hua tha, par department ne section 143(3) se normal assessment kar diya. Search ke baad ka special reassessment process follow nahi kiya.
cases.issue: Kya bina sahi reassessment process follow kiye assessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki proper search procedure follow nahi hua, isliye assessment ko radd kar diya. Normal reassessment search cases mein kaam nahi aata.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke yahaan search hua hai, to department se poori procedure follow karne ka zord den. Bina process kiye assessment chal nahi sakta.

cases.case_name: Ramco Cements Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: Company ne railway siding banwane par kharcha kiya. Department ne ise capital expense maana, revenue expense nahi.
cases.issue: Kya railway siding ka kharcha direct expense hai ya capital?
cases.held: ITAT ne allow kiya ki ye expense revenue hai, bas department ko verify karna hai. Sab kuch records par depend karega.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka infrastructure ka kharcha hai, to detail mein proof rakhein. Verification ke liye bill, agreement sab ready rakho.

cases.case_name: National Housing Bank Vs DCIT (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Bank ne leasehold office premises ke composite cost par depreciation claim kiya tha. Department ne poora amount allow nahi kiya.
cases.issue: Kya composite cost par depreciation mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola poore composite cost par depreciation mil sakta hai. Department ko is baar sahi tariqe se allow karna padega.
cases.takeaway: Agar leasehold office ya aise asset hai, to composite cost par depreciation ka claim submit karo. Sahi working aur break-up ready rakho.

cases.case_name: Quess Corp Ltd. Vs Wardwiz (India) Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Quess Corp ne IBC demand notice wrong pin code par bheja, lekin notice phir bhi deliver ho gaya. Dusri party ne is par objection uthaya ki pin code galat tha.
cases.issue: Kya wrong pin code hone par bhi notice valid hai jab delivery ho gayi ho?
cases.held: NCLAT ne matter wapas bhej diya, par bola ki galat pin code hone se notice khatam nahi ho sakta, agar actual mein serve ho gaya ho.
cases.takeaway: IBC notice bhejte waqt address details sahi hon, phir bhi agar notice pohanch jaaye, to technical error se matter nahi ruke. Delivery prove ho to relief milega.

cases.case_name: ITO Vs Deep Raheja (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Deep Raheja ke yahan income tax department ne search ke baad scrutiny assessment kiya. Assessment Rs 3.05 crore par kiya gaya tha. Department ne search ke aadhaar par additional demand nikaali thi.
cases.issue: Kya search ke aadhaar par ki gayi assessment sahi thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne yeh assessment radd kar diya. Court ne kaha search ki jo basic requirements thi, wo poori nahi hui thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar department aapke khilaaf search assessment rakhe, to check karo ki sab requirements poori ki gayi ya nahi. Galat tareeke se hui assessment ko ITAT radd kar sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Angpal Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Angpal ka accountant resign kar gaya tha, isliye filing mein delay ho gaya. Income tax department ne Rs 1.5 lakh ka penalty lagaya tha kyunki return ya statement late file hua tha.
cases.issue: Kya accountant ke resign karne ki wajah se delay justifiable hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty hata di. Bola ki accountant ke chhorne ki wajah se genuine problem thi, isliye late ho gaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar statement file karne mein delay ho to proof rakho ki kyon delay hua. Genuine reason jaise employee resign ka record kaam aa sakta hai.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Chrysalis Trading Pvt. Ltd. (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: DCIT ne company ke upar section 153C lagaya tha, jo dusre ke documents milne par lagta hai. Satisfaction note defective tha.
cases.issue: Kya defective satisfaction note se assessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne section 153C ki assessment radd kar di kyunki satisfaction note theek se nahi likha gaya tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case mein section 153C lag raha hai, to satisfaction note dhyan se check karo. Galat ya adhura note ho to assessment radd ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Hamdard Laboratories India Vs DCIT. (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Hamdard Laboratories India ne apni books mein depreciation claim kiya tha. Department ne Rs 4.72 lakh ka depreciation disallow kar diya tha.
cases.issue: Kya depreciation disallowance justified tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne yeh disallowance hata diya. Bola ki depreciation claim genuine tha.
cases.takeaway: Depreciation claim ke liye books ki entries aur asset ka use dikhana zaroori hai. Agar sab kuch proper hai to disallowance cancel ho sakta hai.

cases.facts: Union Bank ne excess GST refund claim kiya tha. Department ne limitation ka calculation dispute kiya. Mudda tha ki limitation period har mahine alag se count hoga ya ek hi saal mein.
cases.issue: GST refund ki limitation ka calculation har mahine alag hoga ya total period ke hisaab se?
cases.held: GSTAT ne bola GST refund ka limitation period har mahine ki GSTR-3B filing se alag-alag count hoga, ek saal ekathe nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap har mahine GST refund claim karte ho, to limitation ka dhyaan rakhna hai. Har mahine ki GSTR-3B filing ke hisaab se alag-alag time limit count hogi.

cases.case_name: Rahul Singhal Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Is case mein assessee ke kharche ko fake purchase bola gaya tha. Lekin sales aur stock records department ne maan liye the.
cases.issue: Kya bogus purchase add karna sahi tha jab sales aur stock record sahi the?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha ki agar sales aur stock records pe government ko bharosa hai to fir purchase ko naksali nahi bol sakte. Fake purchase ki addition hata di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke sales aur stock records consistent hain, to sirf purchase ko bogus bolke addition nahi ho sakta.

cases.case_name: GR Infra Projects Limited Ratlam Vs State of Madhya Pradesh and Others (Madhya Pradesh High Court)
cases.facts: Company ko GST ka notice mila Section 74 mein, jisme ke fraud ka clear ilzaam nahi lagaya gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina specific fraud allegation ke Section 74 ka notice valid hai?
cases.held: Court ne notice radd kar diya, bola jab tak seedha fraud ka ilzaam nahi hai, Section 74 notice nahi chal sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar GST department aapko fraud wale section mein notice de aur koi specific fraud ka charge nahi likhe, to aap notice radd karwa sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Anil Agarwal HUF Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Reassessment ki notice bheji gayi thi, lekin Section 143(2) ka notice nahi diya gaya.
cases.issue: Kya bina Section 143(2) notice ke reassessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment ko radd kar diya, bola bina mandatory notice bheje reassessment nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Aapko agar reassessment notice aaye aur Section 143(2) ka alag se notice na aaye, to pura reassessment radd ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Shanta Blankets Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Assessee se cash credits ke source pooche gaye the. Usne identity, paisa kahan se aaya aur transaction asli hai ya nahi, sabit kiya.
cases.issue: Kya Section 68 mein addition tab bhi rahegi jab assessee teeno cheeze prove kar de?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di, bola jab teeno cheezon ka proof hai to Section 68 ka addition nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Aapko Section 68 ke case mein teen cheezon ka proof dikhana hai - identity, paisa kahan se aaya aur transaction asli hai ya nahi. Ye ho gaya to addition nahi banegi.

cases.case_name: Exclusive Motors Pvt. Ltd. Vs Sapan Mohan Garg (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: CoC ne insolvency resolution plan pe limited cheezon pe hi vapas review karna tha. Lekin poore plan ko firse dekhne ko shuru kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya CoC purane resolution plan ko firse pura dekh sakti hai jab sirf kuch muddon par hi review bola gaya ho?
cases.held: NCLAT ne bola ki limited muddon par hi vapas dekhna allowed hai. Poora plan firse mat kholo.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka insolvency plan sirf kuch points ke liye court ne wapas bheja hai, to sirf wahi points dubara dekhe jayenge, poora plan nahi.

cases.case_name: Jagmal Vs Mangal Sales Corporation Through Its Proprietor & Anr. (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Admission se pehle settlement ho gaya tha. Phir bhi insolvency ka order aa gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya admission se pehle party settle kar le to insolvency ki proceedings chal sakti hain?
cases.held: NCLAT ne insolvency order khatam kar diya, bola settlement ho gaya tha to process nahi chalegi.
cases.takeaway: Agar insolvency admission se pehle hi settlement ho jaye, to Section 9 ka process nahi chalega. Order cancel ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Quanta Logistics Pvt. Ltd. Vs Commissioner of Customs (Import-I) (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: Customs department ne apne order mein AI-generated Supreme Court judgments ka rujhan liya jo asli nahi the. Bombay HC ne order ko challenge par quash kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya fake ya AI-generated citation pe adharit customs order valid hai?
cases.held: Bombay HC ne order radd kar diya. Bola, fake case law ya AI judgement pe adharit order nahi chal sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar order mein department ne fake ya AI-generated citation dikhayi ho, to aap High Court jaake poora order radd karwa sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Exclusive Motors Pvt. Ltd. Vs Sapan Mohan Garg (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Ye case ek company ke insolvency process ka tha. CoC (Committee of Creditors) ko wapas sirf kuch muddon pe decide karne ko bola gaya tha. Lekin CoC puri resolution plan ko dobara dekhna chahta tha.
cases.issue: Kya CoC poore resolution plan ko fir se consider kar sakta hai jab sirf kuch hi muddon pe remand hua ho?
cases.held: NCLAT ne bola ki CoC sirf wapas bheje gaye specific muddon pe hi deciding power rakhta hai. Pura plan dobara nahi khol sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar court ya tribunal sirf kuch hi cheezein wapas bheje, to CoC ya creditors pura plan nahi khol sakte, sirf wahi mudde decide honge jo specifically remand pe aaye hain.

cases.case_name: Anil Agarwal HUF Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Tax department ne assessee ke khilaf reassessment proceeding start ki. Par assessee ko mandatory notice nahi diya gaya jo Section 143(2) me required hai.
cases.issue: Kya bina Section 143(2) ka notice bheje reassessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment ko radd kar diya. Bola ki notice dena mandatory hai, bina iske pura case hi khatam ho jata hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar reassessment hua hai to Section 143(2) ka notice dekhna zaroori hai. Agar notice ni mila to poora assessment radd ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Jagmal Vs Mangal Sales Corporation Through Its Proprietor & Anr. (NCLAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Is case me insolvency ki application file hui thi. Lekin jab tak application admit nahi hui thi, tabhi parties ka settlement ho gaya tha.
cases.issue: Kya agar admission se pehle settlement ho jaye to CIRP chalu reh sakta hai?
cases.held: NCLAT ne insolvency order radd kar diya. Bola, admission se pehle agar compromise ya settlement ho jaye to Section 9 ke tahat CIRP nahi chal sakta.
cases.takeaway: Insolvency ki application admit hone se pehle settlement ho jaye to turant uska proof lagwa ke application close karwa lo.

cases.case_name: Shanta Blankets Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Assessee par section 68 lagaya gaya tha kyunki uske accounts me kuch credits the jin ki genuineness department ko doubtful lagi. Assessee ne identity, creditworthiness aur transaction ki sagai dikhadi.
cases.issue: Kya section 68 ka addition tab bhi ho sakta hai jab assessee sab proofs dikhade?
cases.held: ITAT ne section 68 ka addition hata diya kyunki assessee ne identity, creditworthiness aur genuineness sab clear dikhayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke account me kisi se paisa aaya hai, to unka PAN, bank statement, aur paisa aane ki wajah clear dikhana zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: Ito Vs NDW Development Corporation LLP (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Tax department ne ek loan ko unexplained money bol ke addition kar diya. Yeh sirf loan ka ledger head reclassify kiya gaya tha, actual mein fresh entry nahi thi.
cases.issue: Kya sirf entry ka naam badalne se woh unexplained ho sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola sirf reclassification se addition nahi banti. Jab paisa already disclose hua tha, toh uska sirf naam badalna unexplained nahi banata.
cases.takeaway: Aap apne books me kis entry ko kya naam dete ho, uski clear note rakhna chahiye. Sirf terminology ki wajah se addition nahi hoga jab paisa explain ho chuka hai.

cases.case_name: Quanta Logistics Pvt. Ltd. Vs Commissioner of Customs (Import-I) (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: Customs department ne apni order me AI-generated Supreme Court judgment ka reference de diya, jo asli mein exist nahi karti. Importer ne is basis par High Court me challenge kiya.
cases.issue: Kya AI-fabricated judgment pe based order valid hai?
cases.held: Bombay HC ne customs order radd kar diya. Bola ki fabricated ya jhooti judgment pe koi bhi order valid nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke khilaf order aaya hai aur court citation ya judgment lag fake lag raha hai, to usko proof ke saath turant challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Margaret Smith Brahm Bagh Vs DCIT (International Taxation) (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Margaret Smith Brahm Bagh ka case tha. Department ne section 54 exemption isliye deny ki, kyunki unhone original return nahi file kiya tha. Property bechne par capital gain declare nahi hua tha original return me.
cases.issue: Kya section 54 exemption mil sakta hai agar original return nahi file kiya ho?
cases.held: ITAT Jaipur ne mana ki exemption dena mana nahi kiya ja sakta sirf is wajah se ki original return nahi file hua. Court ne assessee ko section 54 ka benefit diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapne original return miss kar diya ho, phir bhi section 54 exemption mil sakta hai. Late return me claim hone par bhi consider hota hai.

cases.case_name: Aavkar Trade Consultants LLP Vs ITO (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: Ye reassessment ka case tha ek aisi LLP ka jo pehle hi defunct ho chuki thi. Department ne us LLP ke naam par notice bheja.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment proceeding chal sakti hai defunct company ke PAN par?
cases.held: Bombay High Court ne keh diya ki defunct company ka PAN use karke assessment ya reassessment nahi chal sakte. Notice radd ho gaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar company ya LLP band ho gayi ho, uske naam par notice valid nahi hai. Defunct entity pe koi action nahi le sakte.

cases.case_name: Omprakash Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Omprakash ne property bech kar cash liya. Department ne penalty laga di section 271D ke under kyunki cash mein transaction hui.
cases.issue: Kya cash mein property sale par 271D penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT Jaipur ne dekha ki practical challenges the aur koi mala fide intention nahi tha. Penalty hata di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Property sale ya other transaction cash mein ho toh bhi penalty nahi lagegi agar koi genuine reason ho aur mala fide nahi ho.

cases.case_name: Satya Narayan Garg Vs ITO (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Satya Narayan Garg par 11.52 lakh rupees ki addition kar di gayi section 69C ke under, jo unexplained expenditure ka section hai.
cases.issue: Kya unexplained expenditure ka addition section 69C mein sahi tha?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition quash kar di. Department adequate evidence nahi de paya ki actual unexplained expenditure hua tha.
cases.takeaway: Section 69C mein addition tabhi chalegi jab department proper evidence de ki kharcha unexplained hai. Aise hi estimate par addition nahi ho sakti.

cases.case_name: Manish Bhatia Kalani & Co. LLP Vs ACIT (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Manish Bhatia Kalani & Co. LLP ki books mein 62 lakh cash entries thi. Department ne is basis par reassessment start kiya.
cases.issue: Kya sirf cash entries ke basis par reassessment valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT Jaipur ne reassessment radd kar diya. Keh diya ki sirf cash entries mention kar dena kaafi nahi hai, specific material hona chahiye.
cases.takeaway: Agar sirf cash entry ya vague reason ho reassessment ke liye, toh usko challenge karo. Concrete evidence chahiye department ko.

cases.case_name: CIT Vs Deccan Education Society (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Deccan Education Society ek trust hai jo education field mein hai. Department ne unki section 10(23C)(iiiab) exemption pe objection uthayi thi.
cases.issue: Kya trust ko 10(23C)(iiiab) ka benefit milega?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne trust ko relief de diya. Section 10(23C)(iiiab) ka benefit available hai agar conditions fulfill ho rahi hai.
cases.takeaway: Educational trust agar eligible criteria pura karta ho to section 10(23C)(iiiab) ka benefit mil sakta hai, chahe department object kare.

cases.case_name: CIT Vs Deccan Education Society (Supreme Court of India)
cases.section: Section 10(23C)(iiiab) – ye Government funded educational institutions ke income ko tax free karta hai.
cases.facts: Deccan Education Society ek educational trust hai. Inhone apne educational activities par income tax exemption mangi. Dept ne is par objection kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya Deccan Education Society ko Section 10(23C)(iiiab) waali tax chhoot mil sakti hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne kaha – agar ek society government grant se chalti hai, to uski educational income par tax nahi lagega, Section 10(23C)(iiiab) ke hesaab se.
cases.takeaway: Agar school ya college fully government grant par chalta hai, to income tax exemption mil sakti hai. Apne saare government grant papers ready rakho aur sahi section likho.

cases.case_name: SPI Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Chennai)
cases.facts: SPI Technologies ek export company hai. US mein sales ke liye ₹8.81 crore ka commission diya. Dept ne bola ki bina TDS kaat ke payment hua hai, isliye expense disallow kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya foreign commission par bina TDS kaate expense allowed hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha – ye commission business ke bahar, foreign agent ko diya gaya hai, aur TDS ki requirement nahi thi. Dept ka disallowance hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap foreign agent ko India ke bahar commission dete ho, toh har case mein TDS zaruri nahi. Agreement aur work location ka dhyan rakho.

cases.case_name: Kushal Jain Vs DCIT (ITAT Jodhpur)
cases.facts: Kushal Jain ki salary par dept ne ₹25,000 ka ekstra taxable income add kiya. Par employer ne pehle hi settlement kar di thi.
cases.issue: Kya income pehle hi employer settlement mein cover ho to dobara tax ho sakti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne yeh addition hata di. Bola, jab employer ne already settlement de diya hai to dobara tax nahi lag sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar employer settlement ya payment letter hai, woh audit ya assessment ke time dikha do. Duplicate addition nahi hone dena.

cases.case_name: Leela Devi Jain Vs ITO (ITAT Raipur)
cases.section: Section 151 – income tax reassessment start karne ki approver authority.
cases.facts: Leela Devi Jain ka case dubara khola (reassessment). Lekin approval galat authority se li gayi thi jo section 151 mein allowed nahi hai.
cases.issue: Kya reassessment approval sahi officer ne nahi diya to puri karwahi valid hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment wapas kar di. Bola, galat authority ki approval pe action nahi chal sakta.
cases.takeaway: Aapko reassessment notice mile toh approval officer ka naam zarur check karo. Galat officer hai toh challenge kar do.

cases.case_name: Income Tax Gazetted Officers Association (ITGOA) & Ors. Vs Union of India & Ors. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: Income Tax Gazetted Officers Association ne apne salary aur policy ki problems government ke samne uthani chahi. Department ya sarkar sun nahi rahi thi.
cases.issue: Kya Association ko 8th Pay Commission ke saamne apni baat rakhne ka haq hai?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne bola ki Association apni complaint 8th Pay Commission ke saamne le ja sakti hai. Court ne yeh permission de di.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap kisi staff body, association ya union mein ho, toh government forums mein directly representation ki permission mil sakti hai, Supreme Court ki guidelines ke hesaab se.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Prakash Chandra (ITAT Indore)
cases.facts: Yahan ek vyakti ne apni books mein cash sales dikhayi thi. Department ne wahi amount ko fir se Section 68 ke tehat taxable maana. Sath mein ₹10 lakh ki gift ka bhi mamla tha.
cases.issue: Kya jo cash sales books mein proper dikhayi gayi ho, uspe fir se Section 68 lag sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne bola, agar cash sales books mein sahi dikhai gayi hai, to Section 68 dubara nahi lag sakta. ₹10 lakh gift ka mamla further enquiry ke liye wapas bhej diya gaya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap cash sales pe Section 68 ka notice paayein, books ki entries ko ache se reconcile karo. Gift ya loan jaise items ka proper evidence tayyar rakho, warna woh matter wapas inquiry ke liye ja sakta hai.

cases.case_name: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Chandigarh)
cases.section: Section 271(1)(c) (Penalty on concealment of income), Section 14A (Disallowance for exempt income)
cases.facts: Yahan ek engineering company ki income par Section 14A ke tehat kuch disallowance estimate ki gayi. Uspe department ne penalty bhi laga di Section 271(1)(c) ke tehat.
cases.issue: Kya estimated disallowance par penalty lag sakti hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne penalty hata di. Bola, agar disallowance sirf estimate par hai, toh penalty nahi lag sakti.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke case mein Section 14A par koi figure estimate hui hai, us basis pe penalty lage to appeal jarur dalein. Tribunal ne estimate par penalty galat mani hai.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Zen Matrix Private Limited (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Company ke fixed assets par deemed rent maana gaya aur usko tax kiya gaya. Lekin jo stock-in-trade tha uski addition hata di gayi.
cases.issue: Fixed assets pe deemed rent lagana sahi hai ya nahi? Kya stock-in-trade add kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: Tribunal ne bola, fixed assets pe deemed rent theek hai. Par stock-in-trade pe addition galat thi, isliye woh hata di.
cases.takeaway: Company assets ka nature sahi classify karo. Fixed assets rent maane ja sakte hain, magar stock-in-trade par nahi. Classification point pe records strong rakho.

cases.case_name: Pooja Agarwal Vs ITO (ITAT Agra)
cases.facts: Yahan cash handler ke khilaaf ₹3.70 crore ka addition Section 69A se kiya gaya. Unhone paison ki source ke papers diye.
cases.issue: Kya cash handler ke pass milne wali rakam Section 69A mein add ki ja sakti hai jab source dikh gaya ho?
cases.held: Tribunal ne evidence man liye aur poori addition hata di. Bola, jab paison ka proper source hai to Section 69A nahi lagta.
cases.takeaway: Jab bhi cash ka mamla ho, uske original source ke documents tayyar raho. Sahi proof hai to addition hat sakti hai.

cases.case_name: Rajlaxmi Petrochem Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Yahan company ka reassessment kiya gaya, baad mein Section 263 ke tehat bhi revision hua. Lekin original reopening ke grounds galat sabit hue.
cases.issue: Kya reopening aur 263 revision, jab pehli reopening hi galat sabit ho jaye?
cases.held: Tribunal ne reassessment aur Section 263 dono ko radd kar diya. Bola, agar pehli reopening ki wajah hi galat thi, to aage ka pura process khatam.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke assessment ke reopening ke reason hi weak ho, toh har subsequent revision bhi challenge ho sakta hai. Original reopening grounds ko evidence se zaroor check karein.

cases.case_name: Venkateswara Agencies Vs Assistant Commissioner (ST) & Others (Andhra Pradesh High Court)
cases.facts: Yahan ek GST assessment order ke khilaaf case tha. Order mein DIN number nahi tha.
cases.issue: Kya bina DIN number wale GST order ko court mein challenge kiya ja sakta hai?
cases.held: High Court ne order ko radd kar diya, kyunki DIN (Document Identification Number) nahi tha. Bola, DIN ki requirement mandatory hai.
cases.takeaway: Har GST order par DIN honi chaiye. Agar nahi hai to turant legal action sochiye; order cancel ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Prakash Chandra (ITAT Indore)
cases.facts: Prakash Chandra ka case tha. Business ke cash sales books mein record ho chuki thi. Department ne fir bhi 10 lakh ka gift Section 68 ke tahat dubara income maan liya.
cases.issue: Kya already books mein dikhaye gaye cash sales dobara Section 68 mein add ho sakte hain?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, agar cash sales pehle hi books mein record hain to Section 68 se dobara tax nahi kar sakte. 10 lakh ka gift ka hisaab sahi se verify karne ke liye matter wapas Assessing Officer ko bhej diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar cash sales seedhe books mein dikhai ho to officer dobara Section 68 se tax nahi laga sakta. Par gift ya loan ke case mein proof dena zaroori hai.

cases.case_name: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Limited Vs ITO (ITAT Chandigarh)
cases.section: Section 271(1)(c) (penalty for concealment) aur Section 14A (expenditure on exempt income)
cases.facts: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Limited par Section 14A ki estimation basis par expenditure disallow hone par penalty lagayi gayi thi. Company ne argue ki penalty nahi banti.
cases.issue: Estimated Section 14A disallowance pe penalty lagana sahi hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne kaha ke jab disallowance sirf estimate pe ho, to Section 271(1)(c) ki penalty nahi lagayi ja sakti. Penalty ko hata diya.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka Section 14A ka disallowance sirf estimate pe hai, to us basis pe penalty nahi lagni chahiye. Department agar lagata hai to appeal kijiye.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Zen Matrix Private Limited (ITAT Ahmedabad)
cases.facts: Zen Matrix Pvt Ltd ka case tha. Department ne fixed assets pe deemed rent maana aur stock-in-trade pe bhi addition kari.
cases.issue: Kya fixed assets pe deemed rent lagana theek hai aur stock-in-trade ka addition valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola, fixed assets pe deemed rent lag sakta hai. Lekin, stock-in-trade pe addition galat tha, wo hata di gayi.
cases.takeaway: Fixed assets agar vacant hai to deemed rent add ho sakta hai, lekin stock-in-trade pe addition ke liye sahi basis dikhana padega.

cases.case_name: Pooja Agarwal Vs ITO (ITAT Agra)
cases.facts: Pooja Agarwal ka case tha. Uske khilaf Rs. 3.70 crore ki addition section 69A ke tahat ki gayi thi cash handling ke basis par.
cases.issue: Kya cash handler ke khilaf section 69A ki addition sahi thi?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di. Lagta hai court ko justification theek nahi laga.
cases.takeaway: Cash ke source ka proof sahi hai to section 69A ki addition delete ho sakti hai. Jab bhi cash transaction ho, sari entry aur receipts sambhal kar rakho.

cases.case_name: Rajlaxmi Petrochem Pvt. Ltd. Vs ITO (ITAT Pune)
cases.facts: Rajlaxmi Petrochem Pvt. Ltd. ka case hai. Department ne pehle reassessment kiya, fir Section 263 ke tahat order revise kiya. Par jo pehle reopening ke reasons the, wo fail ho gaye.
cases.issue: Agar asli reopening ke reasons fail ho jayein to reassessment aur revision survive karte hain ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne reassessment aur Section 263 dono orders ko radd kar diya kyunki original reopening ground hi fail ho gaya tha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapki reassessment sirf galat ya fail reason par hai to usko challenge karo. Department har case mein dobaara revision nahi kar sakta.

cases.case_name: Venkateswara Agencies Vs Assistant Commissioner (ST) & Others (Andhra Pradesh High Court)
cases.facts: Venkateswara Agencies ka GST assessment order tha. Uspe DIN (Document Identification Number) nahi tha. Department ne order pass kar diya bina DIN ke.
cases.issue: Kya bina DIN ke GST assessment order valid hai?
cases.held: High Court ne GST order bina DIN ke radd kar diya. DIN ka hona mandatory hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapke GST order pe DIN nahi hai to turant usko challenge karo. DIN compulsory hai, bina uske order nahi chal sakta.

cases.case_name: Sandeep Gupta Vs JM Financial Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd. & Anr. (NCLAT New Delhi)
cases.facts: Asian Hotels insolvency chal raha tha. CoC ne full-dues settlement proposal aaya tha, lekin bina theek wajah ke mana kar diya. Company ne challenge kiya yeh decision.
cases.issue: Kya CoC settlement offer bina reason ke reject kar sakta hai?
cases.held: NCLAT ne insolvency process ko radd kar diya. Bola CoC ka rejection arbitrary tha, har proposal ka logic se evaluation zaroori hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap CoC hain, settlement ko bina explanation reject mat karo. Har decision ka likhit reason hona chahiye, warna process khatam ho sakta hai.

cases.case_name: Ashutosh Bhargava Vs PCIT (ITAT Jaipur)
cases.facts: Assessee ka Section 263 revision notice aaya. Department ne poora mauka nahi diya jawab dene ka. Sunwai properly nahi hui.
cases.issue: Kya bina theek sunwai ke Section 263 revision valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne revision ko radd kar diya. Kaaha, fair hearing ke bina aisa revision notice nahi chal sakta.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko Section 263 ka notice mile, department ko likhit jawab dene ka mauka maange aur sunwai proper ho toh hi action valid maana jaayega.

cases.case_name: DCIT Vs Skyway Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd. (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Company ne unsecured loan liya. Department ne loans add back kiye kyunki creditworthiness aur genuineness prove nahi hui.
cases.issue: Unsecured loan tab allow hoga jab assessee prove kare ki paisa legit hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne additions ko uphold kiya. Bola, proof ki kami thi ki paisa sach mein loan tha ya nahi, isliye disallow kiya.
cases.takeaway: Aap unsecured loan le rahe ho toh, lender ka bank statement aur source of funds ka proper proof ready rakho. Sirf entry se kaam nahi chalega.

cases.case_name: Samriddhi Petro Products Private Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Hyderabad)
cases.facts: Company par Section 263 ke tahat revision proceedings shuru ho gayi. Assessee ko poori sunwai ka mauka nahi mila.
cases.issue: Kya bina sunwai ke Section 263 revision chal sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne case wapas department ko bhej diya fresh sunwai ke liye. Bola bina full hearing ke order pass nahi ho sakta.
cases.takeaway: Section 263 ka notice aaye to apni taraf se har proof jama karwao aur proper sunwai ka demand likhit mein karo.

cases.case_name: Union of India Vs M.T.N.L. & Anr. (Supreme Court of India)
cases.facts: BOCW Cess matter me appeal file karne ke liye pre-deposit maanga gaya tha. Parties ne is pre-deposit ki legality Delhi HC me challenge ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya BOCW Cess appeal me pre-deposit ka rule valid hai ya nahi?
cases.held: Supreme Court ne Delhi HC ka decision barkarar rakha, interfere nahi kiya. Matlab pre-deposit ka rule bana raha.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko BOCW Cess pe appeal file karni hai, toh pre-deposit ke rule ki tayari pehle se kar lo, bina paisa deposit kiye appeal entertain nahi hogi.

cases.case_name: Anilkumar Khanderao Pawar Vs Directorate of Enforcement & Anr. (Bombay High Court)
cases.facts: ED ne ek aadmi ko evidence ke bina arrest kar liya. Accused ne arrest ko challenge kiya court mein.
cases.issue: Kya bina pakke evidence ke ED kisi ko arrest kar sakti hai?
cases.held: Bombay HC ne bola ki tangible evidence ke bina arrest galat hai. ED ko law follow karna hoga.
cases.takeaway: Agar ED summon ya arrest kare to proper documents maange aur bina evidence ke arrest ya investigation ko turant challenge karo.

cases.case_name: Ritu Agarwal Vs ACIT (ITAT Lucknow)
cases.section: Section 271(1)(c) - Penalty for concealment/misreporting of income
cases.facts: Ritu Agarwal ka case tha. Tax officer ne penalty lagayi Section 271(1)(c) mein, par notice aur order mein alag alag charge likh diya. Penalty isi confusion pe based thi.
cases.issue: Jab notice aur order mein alag alag reason ho penalty ka, to penalty valid hai ya nahi?
cases.held: ITAT ne penalty radd kar di. Bola, agar notice aur order mein mismatch ho jaye toh assessee ko clear nahi pata ki uspar kya ilzam hai.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapko penalty ka notice aaye aur usme aur order mein alag-alag reason likha ho, toh is point ko appeal mein utha sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Aegis Customer Support Services Pvt Ltd. Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Aegis Customer Support Services Pvt Ltd par ₹37.95 crore ka CCD interest TP adjustment lagaya gaya. ₹6.53 crore ka service charges bhi dispute tha.
cases.issue: TP adjustment mein interest aur service charges ko kaise treat karein?
cases.held: ITAT ne ₹37.95 crore ka TP adjustment hata diya. ₹6.53 crore service charges wapas department ko jaane bhej diye further check ke liye.
cases.takeaway: Aapke TP adjustment case mein interest waale part pe strong facts ho toh relief mil sakti hai. Service charges jaise items department mein properly justify karne honge.

cases.case_name: Mahaveer Jeerawala Vs DCIT (ITAT Jodhpur)
cases.facts: Mahaveer Jeerawala ka completed assessment pe search hua. Department ne Section 153A ke under naya addition kar diya.
cases.issue: Kya poore ho chuke assessment mein bina naya material ke addition ho sakta hai search ke baad?
cases.held: ITAT ne saaf bola, jab tak search mein naya incriminating material nahi milta, completed assessment mein additions nahi ho sakte.
cases.takeaway: Agar aapka assessment search ke pehle complete tha aur search mein kuch naya nahi mila, additions challenge kar sakte hain.

cases.case_name: Vikas Jain Vs DC Central Circle-2 (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Vikas Jain par penny stock ka addition ho gaya. Par search/raid mein koi naya proof nahi mila jo directly uske case ko connect karta ho.
cases.issue: Bina naya search material ke, kya penny stock addition valid hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata di, bola bina incriminating search material ke addition nahi ho sakta under search assessment.
cases.takeaway: Penny stock ya any addition agar search ke baad kiye hain to check karein ki kya actual incriminating material mila bhi tha ya nahi.

cases.facts: Ek aadmi par SIL license ke wrong use ka ilzam tha. Department ne bola customs broker (CB) ki galti hai over-debiting mein. Lekin department apne pass proof nahi dikha paya ki broker ka actual role tha ya nahi.
cases.issue: Kya bina proof ke customs broker par zimmedari daali ja sakti hai?
cases.held: CESTAT ne bola department ne sahi tarah se CB ka role establish nahi kiya. Appeal allow ho gayi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap customs broker hain aur department aap par zimmedari daal raha hai, to proof ki demand karein. Sirf ilzam se zimmedari nahi aati.

cases.case_name: Shree Madhi Vibhag Khand Udyog Sahakari Mandli Ltd. Vs PCIT (ITAT Surat)
cases.facts: Yeh co-operative bank ka case tha. Department ne Section 263 ka use karke interest deduction ko lekar revision kiya tha.
cases.issue: Kya department Section 263 lagakar co-operative bank ke interest deduction ko wapas khol sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne revision ko radd kar diya. Court ko laga ki department ki taraf se galat tareeke se revision li gayi thi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap co-operative entity hain aur interest deduction sahi diya hai, to Section 263 ke through galat revision court mein tik nahi sakti.

cases.case_name: Vodafone Digilink Limited Vs DCIT (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Vodafone par ₹296.15 crore ka transfer pricing adjustment lagaya gaya tha, mainly royalty aur AMP (advertisement/marketing) expenses ko lekar.
cases.issue: Kya royalty aur AMP expenses par transfer pricing adjustment sahi hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne Vodafone ke khilaf ki gayi transfer pricing adjustment ko hata diya. Unhone dekha ki yeh expenses business ke hisaab se valid the.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap royalty ya marketing expenses par transfer pricing adjustment face kar rahe hain, to har ek expense ko business purpose aur agreement ke document se justify karna zaruri hai.

cases.case_name: Girdharlal Brothers Vs ACIT/JCIT/DCIT/ACIT/ITO (ITAT Mumbai)
cases.facts: Girdharlal Brothers ne tenancy rights surrender kiye the. Department ne value uthane ke liye Section 50C lagaya aur ₹38.48 lakh ka addition kiya.
cases.issue: Kya tenancy rights ke surrender par Section 50C lagti hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne addition hata diya. Bola ki Section 50C sirf immovable property transfer par lagti hai, tenancy rights par nahi.
cases.takeaway: Agar aap tenancy rights surrender kar rahe hain, to Section 50C ka valuation provision aap par nahi lagega.

cases.case_name: Khathu Shyam Jangid Brahman Dharamshala Vs ITO (E) (ITAT Delhi)
cases.facts: Dharamshala ko Section 12AA ka registration appeal ke dauraan mila. Pehle ke assessment year ke liye exemption claim kiya.
cases.issue: Kya appeal mein registration milne par pehle ke year ka exemption mil sakta hai?
cases.held: ITAT ne bola ki registration milte hi pichhle saal ka bhi exemption mil jaata hai.
cases.takeaway: Trusts/NGOs ko appeal mein registration mil jaaye to pichhle years ki exemption bhee claim ki ja sakti hai.

cases.facts: Ek company par ₹3.83 crore ka CVD (Additional Duty of Customs) demand lagaya tha. Laptops free distribute kiye ja rahe the aur RSP (retail sale price) declare nahi ki thi.
cases.issue: Kya bina RSP declare kiye free laptops par RSP-based CVD lag sakta hai?
